name: list-item
title: List Item
description: Configurable row with leading, secondary, trailing, density, muted or accent variants, readOnly presentational rows, and as="button" or asChild link hosts. Includes ListItemLabel for menu and nav section headings, and ListItemNest for indented child groups with an optional guide line. Option List, Select, Combobox, Tag Input, Contents Nav, Sidebar, and Dropdown Menu compose these for selectable options, outlines, and app nav.

api.description: Configurable row for menus, pickers, TOC, and app navigation. Compose leading, secondary, and trailing slots. Pair with ListItemLabel for section headings and ListItemNest for indented child groups with an optional guide line. Option List, Select, Combobox, Tag Input, Contents Nav, Sidebar, and Dropdown Menu compose List Item. Use as="button" for in-page actions. Use asChild to paint the row onto a link. Pass itemChrome on composer roots for shared defaults, or set chrome props on each row. Chrome props set --df-list-item-* variables so padding, gap, type (size, family, weight, color), radius, fills, and stroke can be overridden per row.

groups.title: ListItem
groups.description: Row chrome, density, host element, and presentational state.

props.name: size
props.description: Density and type size. xs is nest and TOC child (text-11). sm is TOC parent (text-13). md matches Option List and the left index (text-sm). lg is roomier. For muted, each size has its own density recipe. Override further with padding and fontSize props.

props.name: variant
props.description: accent uses picker hover and selected fills. muted uses quiet nav fills for catalogue and TOC rows. Density for muted is per size. Override fills with background, hoverBackground, and selectedBackground.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected or current row appearance.

props.name: highlighted
props.description: Hover or keyboard highlight without selecting.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Non-interactive row. Sets aria-disabled and dims the row. On as="button", also sets the native disabled attribute.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Presentational row for reading only. Keeps size, variant, and selected appearance with no hover, press, focus, or activation. Distinct from disabled, which dims the row. Option List, Select, Dropdown Menu, Contents Nav, and Combobox options skip or forward readOnly through the same contract.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state for submenu-style rows. Sets data-open. Independent of selected, which sets data-state.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading slot. Pass an icon, "checkbox" or "check" for selection marks, or false to omit. Icons use the icon track by default. For Avatar or other non-icon marks, set leadingFit to content. In columns layout, pass text; the slot hugs content. Set aria-hidden on decorative icons.

props.name: leadingFit
props.description: Track size for custom leading nodes. icon keeps the mark box used by row icons. content sizes the track to the node. Use content for Avatar, media, or text marks. Ignored for checkbox and check. Stacked rows with content center the leading, label stack, and trailing as one group.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Supporting copy beside or under the label. Long title and secondary text truncate with an ellipsis when the row is narrower than the copy.

props.name: layout
props.description: inline places secondary beside the label. stacked places it underneath. columns is a three-column text row: leading, main label, and trailing. The main label stays horizontally centered in the row. Leading and trailing hug their tracks. Height follows content. columns does not require secondary.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End slot for badges, chevrons, measures, or actions. Stays end-aligned with margin-inline-start auto when the row spans its parent. For nested menu affordances, pass ListItemSubmenuChevron so size matches the indicator slot. When List Item is an OptionListTrigger render host, set OptionList width fill (or a fixed length) so the row has width to push against. In columns layout, use for end-aligned text such as a size value.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Reserve an end check slot. The check shows when selected. The slot stays end-aligned with auto space before it; --df-list-item-gap is the minimum space from the label. Long labels truncate.

props.name: as
props.description: Native host when asChild is false. Use button for clickable rows without navigation. Ignored when asChild is true.

props.name: asChild
props.description: When true, List Item does not render its own wrapper. Pass one child element (usually a link). That element becomes the clickable row and keeps its own href or routing. Prefer this over wrapping List Item in a separate link. The child text is the label.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text by default. With asChild, pass a single element such as <a> or <Link> instead.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the host.

groups.title: Chrome overrides
groups.description: String props write --df-list-item-* on the host. Prefer token expressions such as var(--muted), var(--border-width-hairline), or calc(2 * var(--spacing-unit)). Size and variant still supply defaults when a prop is omitted. OptionListItem, SelectItem, Combobox, Tag Input, and ContentsNavItem forward the same props. Root itemChrome sets defaults for every row; per-item props win.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on all sides. Sets each --df-list-item-padding-* side.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding. Sets --df-list-item-padding-left and --df-list-item-padding-right. Overrides padding on those sides.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical padding. Sets --df-list-item-padding-top and --df-list-item-padding-bottom. Overrides padding on those sides.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Top padding. Sets --df-list-item-padding-top and wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Right padding. Sets --df-list-item-padding-right and wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Bottom padding. Sets --df-list-item-padding-bottom and wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Left padding. Sets --df-list-item-padding-left and wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: gap
props.description: Minimum space between leading, label, trailing, and indicator slots. Sets --df-list-item-gap.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Label type size. Prefer type tokens such as var(--df-text-11). Sets --df-list-item-font-size.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: Label font family. Prefer family tokens such as var(--df-font-sans) or var(--df-font-mono). Sets --df-list-item-font-family.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Label font weight. Prefer weight tokens such as var(--df-font-weight-semibold). Sets --df-list-item-font-weight. Accent titles default to medium when omitted; muted defaults to normal.

props.name: background
props.description: Resting fill. Sets --df-list-item-bg.

props.name: foreground
props.description: Resting label color. Sets --df-list-item-fg.

props.name: hoverBackground
props.description: Hover, highlight, and focus fill. Sets --df-list-item-hover-bg.

props.name: hoverForeground
props.description: Hover, highlight, and focus label color. Sets --df-list-item-hover-fg.

props.name: selectedBackground
props.description: Selected fill. Also sets selected hover fill unless selectedHoverBackground is passed. Sets --df-list-item-selected-bg and --df-list-item-selected-hover-bg.

props.name: selectedForeground
props.description: Selected label color. Sets --df-list-item-selected-fg.

props.name: selectedHoverBackground
props.description: Selected row hover fill. Sets --df-list-item-selected-hover-bg.

props.name: activeBackground
props.description: Pressed fill. Sets --df-list-item-active-bg.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the row fill and stroke. Prefer radius tokens such as var(--radius-md) or var(--radius-2xl). Sets --df-list-item-radius.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Stroke width. Prefer border tokens such as var(--border-width-hairline). Default 0 (no stroke). Sets --df-list-item-border-width.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Stroke color. Prefer var(--border) or other color tokens. Sets --df-list-item-border-color.

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: Stroke style such as solid or dashed. Default solid. Sets --df-list-item-border-style.

groups.title: ListItemLabel
groups.description: Section heading above a group of rows (data-df list-item-section). OptionListLabel and SelectLabel use the menu variant.

props.name: variant
props.description: menu is the quiet picker group title (Option List). nav is the uppercase mono catalogue section title.

props.name: children
props.description: Section title text.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles.

groups.title: ListItemSubmenuChevron
groups.description: Nested menu affordance for the trailing slot. Uses the same size box as the indicator check and muted foreground. Dropdown Menu injects it when a submenu trigger has no custom trailing. Pass it from Option List and Sidebar rows that open nested panels.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the chevron host.

groups.title: ListItemNest
groups.description: Indented group for nested rows. Optional guide line via line. Chrome props write --df-list-item-nest-* on the host. Provides nest scope so ContentsNavItem defaults to nestItemSize inside the group.

props.name: line
props.description: When true, paints the nest guide line. When false, keeps indent without a line.

props.name: indent
props.description: Outer inset before the nest group. Prefer spacing tokens. Sets --df-list-item-nest-indent.

props.name: pad
props.description: Inner pad after the guide line. Prefer spacing tokens. Sets --df-list-item-nest-pad.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between nested rows. Sets --df-list-item-nest-gap.

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Guide line thickness. Prefer var(--border-width-hairline). Sets --df-list-item-nest-line-width.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Guide line color. Prefer var(--border). Sets --df-list-item-nest-line-color.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested List Item rows.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-list-item-padding-top
props.description: Top padding. Set by padding, paddingY, or paddingTop.

props.name: --df-list-item-padding-right
props.description: Right padding. Set by padding, paddingX, or paddingRight.

props.name: --df-list-item-padding-bottom
props.description: Bottom padding. Set by padding, paddingY, or paddingBottom.

props.name: --df-list-item-padding-left
props.description: Left padding. Set by padding, paddingX, or paddingLeft.

props.name: --df-list-item-gap
props.description: Minimum space between leading, label, trailing, and indicator slots. Set by the gap prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-indicator-size
props.description: Width and height of the end check slot when indicator is on.

props.name: --df-list-item-font-size
props.description: Label type size. Set by data-size recipes, or by the fontSize chrome prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-radius
props.description: Row corner radius. Set by the radius prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-bg
props.description: Resting fill. Set by the background prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-fg
props.description: Resting label color. Set by the foreground prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-hover-bg
props.description: Hover and highlight fill. Set by the hoverBackground prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-hover-fg
props.description: Hover and highlight label color. Set by the hoverForeground prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-selected-bg
props.description: Selected fill. Set by the selectedBackground prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-selected-fg
props.description: Selected label color. Set by the selectedForeground prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-selected-hover-bg
props.description: Selected hover fill. Set by selectedHoverBackground or selectedBackground.

props.name: --df-list-item-active-bg
props.description: Pressed fill. Set by the activeBackground prop.

props.name: --accent
props.description: Default accent hover and selected recipe.

props.name: --muted
props.description: Default muted selected and hover recipe.

props.name: --muted-foreground
props.description: Default muted resting label color.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-indent
props.description: Outer nest inset. Set by ListItemNest indent.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-pad
props.description: Inner nest pad. Set by ListItemNest pad.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-gap
props.description: Gap between nested rows. Set by ListItemNest gap.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-line-width
props.description: Nest guide thickness. Set by ListItemNest lineWidth.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-line-color
props.description: Nest guide color. Set by ListItemNest lineColor.
